title: fix(plugin-tree): tree cells draw the list cell faces, so a boolean no longer shows as `true` (objectui#11686)
body:
Fixes #11686

Clause-②: no — tree cells start drawing through the faces list cells already use; no export, prop, type member or i18n key is added to anything a package entry reaches.

## What was wrong

Setup → Business Units, Org Chart tab. That tab is `sys_business_unit`'s `org_chart` list view (`type: 'tree'`), which `ListView`'s `case 'tree'` branch hands to `object-tree`, so it is drawn by `ObjectTree` in this package. Its cell formatter `formatCellValue` handled two families (fields carrying `options`, and expanded references) and ended in `return String(value);` for everything else. So the boolean `active` column printed `true`, and dates, numbers and currency printed their stored form.

## What changed

- **`packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx`**: new `renderTreeCell`. A cell whose column has a DECLARED type now draws through `getCellRenderer(resolveCellRendererType(field))` from `@object-ui/fields`. That is the two-step the grid (`resolveGridCellRendering`), the kanban card, the gallery card and the report viewer use. The face receives the column definition plus four values:
  - `name`: the column key, which `BooleanCellRenderer` and the date faces read;
  - `type`: the renderer key, as the grid's `fieldMeta.type` carries it;
  - `options`: translated through `translateOptions`, the same call the grid makes;
  - `label`: the label the tree's header prints.

  A column with no declared type (one the object does not define, or a schema-less mount) keeps `formatCellValue`'s string. The label column and the other columns both go through `renderTreeCell`. The record overlay's plain-reading fallback is unchanged.
- **`packages/plugin-tree/package.json`**: declares `@object-ui/fields` as `workspace:*`, as plugin-kanban, plugin-grid and plugin-report do. There is no cycle, because fields depends on nothing that depends on plugin-tree. plugin-tree already reached fields at runtime: it imports `@object-ui/plugin-detail` statically, and plugin-detail's built entry imports `@object-ui/fields` statically. So this edge adds no module to any bundle closure.
- **`pnpm-lock.yaml`**: only the matching three-line importer entry.
- **`.changeset/11686-tree-cell-display-faces.md`**: a patch for `@object-ui/plugin-tree`.

Behaviour a reviewer will see beyond the card:
- A `lookup` cell now draws `LookupCellRenderer`. It links to the referenced record when the host publishes a record href; that link stops propagation, so the row click does not also fire. An id that was not expanded is resolved by name on demand.
- A `user` cell now draws the avatar face.
- The label cell gains the text face's hover `title`. An empty label draws the shared empty-value affordance: the same dash, now with an accessible name.

## Measured before editing (dispatch hypotheses H1–H4)

- **H1 holds.** The formatter ends in `return String(value);`, and three call sites print its result: the label column, the other columns, and the overlay fallback. The Org Chart is drawn by this package (path above).
- **H2.** The lookup is `getCellRenderer` + `resolveCellRendererType`, published by `@object-ui/fields`, which plugin-tree did not declare.
- **H3.** The string is used only for display. Nothing in the tree reads it for search, client sort or an accessible name, so returning an element changes nothing else.
- **H4.** The list's boolean face draws a read-only checkbox for `true`, with no words. For `false` on a status-named field (`active`, `enabled` and so on) it draws a badge reading "FIELD-LABEL — Off". The label half is localized here, because the header's translated label is handed to the face. The word `Off`, and the completion indicator's `Completed` / `Not completed` accessible names, are hard-coded English in `BooleanCellRenderer` itself; see Acceptance notes.

## Tests

New `ObjectTree.cellFaces-11686.test.tsx`. It mounts the tree the way `ListView` does (live dataSource plus inline data) with `sys_business_unit` columns, and pins:
- boolean `true` draws the checkbox (`aria-checked="true"`), not `true`. Boolean `false` on `active` draws the face's badge, not `false`.
- date, currency and select cells are byte-equal (`innerHTML`) to the list face rendered on its own for the same field and value.
- a column the object does not define keeps its plain string (the declared bound).
- **the card's pin.** Under a `zh` provider with `fields.sys_business_unit.active` set to 启用, the Active column draws the checkbox for `true`. For `false` it draws a badge naming 启用 (not `Active`), the same word as the header.

The six objectui#6014 pins in `ObjectTree.fieldFormatting.test.tsx` (lookup name, `$expand`, option label, case-insensitive match, `fieldOptions` i18n, plain value) pass unchanged through the faces.

**Reverse check (ablation)**, run from committed state with `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode:
- Mutation: `renderTreeCell` always returns the old string. Anchor hits went 1 → 0; blob `9a76f60b` → `b395115b`.
- Result: 4 failed / 7 passed.
  - Each of the four face pins went red at its own assertion: `expected 'true' not to contain 'true'`, `expected 'false' not to contain 'false'`, `expected '2024-03-05' not to be '2024-03-05'`, and the zh pin's `true`.
  - The untyped-bound pin and the six objectui#6014 pins stayed green.
- Restore proven: blob back to `9a76f60b` == HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- An earlier run turned all five new pins red at a shared wait-for-a-checkbox helper, so it showed nothing per pin. That helper now waits on a signal the old code also produced (commit `506a6e5`), and the result above is from the rerun.

## Acceptance notes (not changed here)

- **Boolean face words.** In `BooleanCellRenderer` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx`), the badge word `Off` and the completion indicator's `Completed` / `Not completed` accessible names are hard-coded English on every list surface, and now the tree too. They are the same family as the read-only `Yes` / `No` words carded in objectui#11689, but sit in a file that card does not list. They are named for that card's scope, not changed here (this claim adds no i18n key).
- **Grid label divergence.** The grid hands its cell face the authored `fieldDef.label` while its header resolves the translated label. So under a non-en pack the grid's Off badge names the column in the authored language, while the tree's (after this PR) names it like its header. Same family as above.
- **UMD global names.** plugin-tree's `vite.config.ts` names no UMD global for `@object-ui/fields` (new here), `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/permissions` or `react/jsx-runtime`. The build warns `MISSING_GLOBAL_NAME` and guesses a name for each. ESM output is unaffected.
